resources.string: Replace recovery phrase
Get 12 new words. Backups made before keep needing the old ones.
Replace the recovery phrase?

You will get 12 new words. The old phrase stops unlocking your notes on this phone. Backups you already made still open only with the old phrase, so keep it as long as you keep them, or make a new backup afterwards.
Get new words
Your old phrase stops working here
Once you confirm, only these words unlock your notes if you forget the PIN. Backups made before still need the old words.
Recovery phrase replaced. Make a new backup to use it for backups too.
Privacy
Strict keyboard privacy
Asks the keyboard for no suggestions, no cloud prediction and no reading around the cursor. Turns off autocorrect, and some keyboards hide emoji or voice input.
Lock after leaving the app
How long Encly stays open when you switch to another app. Turning off the screen or locking the phone always locks it at once.
Immediately
After 15 seconds
After 30 seconds
After 1 minute
After 2 minutes
How Encly protects your notes
A random 256-bit key
The whole database is encrypted with a key made on this phone.
A PIN bound to this phone
Your PIN is mixed with a key in the phone\'s secure chip, so it can\'t be guessed anywhere else.
Separate locks for each way in
PIN, recovery phrase and fingerprint each open their own encrypted slot. Fingerprint needs your finger every time.
Danger zone
Hold for 5 seconds to erase
Wipe PIN
A second PIN that erases your notes when typed on the lock screen
Turned off when your PIN key was reset. Set it again if you used one.
If someone makes you open Encly, type the wipe PIN instead of your PIN. Encly erases your notes, tasks and tags without any sign and opens as an empty vault. It works only on the lock screen.
Backup files you already exported are not touched. They still open with your recovery phrase and are the only way back.
Biometric unlock stays on: someone can force your finger onto the sensor. Turn it off if that is a risk for you.
Turn off biometric unlock

It protects you when someone forces you to unlock, not against a forensic examination of the phone. During a lockout the wipe PIN can\'t be used either. Encly never shows whether a wipe PIN is set: a new one replaces the old one, and changing your PIN to the wipe PIN turns it off.
